notes: Concept note section 4: missing or unrecognized UCUM units fail the numeric target shape.
Concept note section 2: never drop a unit code/system while claiming an unqualified numeric result.
The unit's display text stays in the FHIR source layer; the UCUM code is the normalised binding.

ucum_snapshot.acquisition: offline. Hand-pinned from the concept note's worked examples (sections 4 and 5).
ucum_snapshot.ucum_expression_parsing_note: This resolver does NOT parse arbitrary UCUM expressions. It matches pinned literal codes. Anything else is an explicit outcome, never a guess.

defaults_rationale.unknown_unit_code: Concept note section 4 failure variants: 'missing or unrecognized UCUM units fail this numeric target shape'. Rejected, not source-only, because a numeric quantity without a known unit is exactly the unqualified numeric assertion the contract forbids.
defaults_rationale.unknown_unit_system: A non-UCUM unit system is not a UCUM code. Rejected rather than reinterpreted.
defaults_rationale.conversion: No unit conversion in the pilot. A convertible-but-different unit (for example kPa where mm[Hg] is expected) is rejected, not silently normalised.

review_status_values.pilot-provisional: Engineering default from the concept note. Interpretable, clinical_signoff FALSE.
review_status_values.proposed: Not usable; yields rejected under this policy because a numeric target needs a usable unit.

egfr-rate.description: Volume rate normalised to body surface area, as used for estimated glomerular filtration rate.

pressure.description: Pressure, as used for blood pressure.

units.provenance: Concept note section 4 worked example A; the unit IRI local name matches its schematic target graph.
Concept note section 5 worked example B.

Present so that a dimension-compatible but non-approved unit has a recorded outcome rather than falling through the unknown-code branch. Yields rejected while status is proposed; conversion to mm[Hg] is disabled.

reviewer_questions: U1: should an unrecognised UCUM code be rejected (current default, following concept note section 4) or retained as source-only with no numeric quantity, the way dataAbsentReason is handled?
U2: should the pilot ever convert units (for example kPa to mm[Hg]), or stay conversion-disabled so the source unit is the only unit asserted? Current default: disabled.
